PREFIX ref: <https://example.com/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?zoneName ?ts
WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:AirHandlingUnit .
  ?ahu brick:hasName "AHU03" .
  ?ahu brick:feeds ?zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a brick:AirTemperature .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?eref .
  ?eref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  OPTIONAL { ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneName }
}

SELECT (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) ?p
WHERE { ?p a <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#AirTemperature> }
GROUP BY ?p
LIMIT 5

SELECT ?s (COUNT(*) AS ?n)
WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }
GROUP BY ?s
ORDER BY DESC(?n)
LIMIT 30
